description: QR code that joins WiFi networks on scan.

faqs.a: Phones read a special WIFI: string encoded in the QR code. When scanned, the phone offers to join that network automatically.
faqs.q: How does a WiFi QR code work?

faqs.a: The SSID and password are embedded in the QR image itself, so anyone who scans it can join. Do not post it publicly if the network is private.
faqs.q: Is it safe to share my WiFi QR code?

faqs.a: Yes — choose “Open (no password)” and leave the password field empty.
faqs.q: Can I make a QR code for an open network?

howto: Enter the password and pick the encryption type.
Tick “Hidden SSID” only if your network does not broadcast its name.
Click Generate, then download the QR code as a PNG.
title: WiFi QR Code Generator
